title: Near-Optimal Covering Sequences
summary: An $(n,R)$-covering sequence over a finite alphabet $Σ_q = \{0,1,\dots, q-1\}$ is a cyclic sequence whose consecutive length-$n$ windows form a covering code of radius $R$. Equivalently, every word in $Σ_q^n$ is within Hamming distance $R$ of at least one window. We give a deterministic and explicit construction of such sequences whose length, for every fixed alphabet size $q$, every fixed radius $R$, and every sufficiently large $n$, attains the sphere-covering lower bound up to a constant factor depending only on $q$ and $R$.
